# Darschin (درس‌چین)

Darschin is a Persian university course-timetabling web application for department managers.

Canonical URL: https://darschin.vercel.app/
Source code: https://github.com/Hhhkarimi/darschin
Creator: Hossein Karimi — https://www.linkedin.com/in/hossein-karimi-8a452153/

## Capabilities
- Define course sections and independent weekly sessions.
- Enforce supported hard constraints for instructors, student groups, rooms, closures, fixed times, fixed rooms, capacity, room type, and required equipment.
- Optimize configurable soft preferences.
- Offer a fast in-browser heuristic and an exact-mode CP-SAT service for up to 40 course sections.
- Export JSON, CSV, and Excel reports.

## Limitations
- A CP-SAT result is described as proven optimal only when the solver status is OPTIMAL.
- A FEASIBLE result is valid for the checked model but not proven globally optimal.
- Partial schedules may contain unscheduled sessions and are labeled accordingly.
- Data sent to exact mode is processed transiently by the Vercel function and is not intentionally persisted by the application.
